q: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth glorifies Allaah
(even though man may not perceive them).
He is the Mighty, the Wise.
v.s: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts God, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
v.c: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth glorifies Allah. For He ˹alone˺ is the Almighty, All-Wise.

q: O you who have Imaan! Why do you say that
v.s: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
v.c: O believers! Why do you say what you do not do?

q: It is indeed a most hateful thing in the sight of Allaah that you say that
v.s: Great is hatred in the sight of God that you say what you do not do.
v.c: How despicable it is in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do!

q: (in front of the enemy with steadfastness and unity)
as if they are a solid building.
v.s: Indeed, God loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.
v.c: Surely Allah loves those who fight in His cause in ˹solid˺ ranks as if they were one concrete structure.

q: (The enemies of Islaam will continue to harass the Muslims as they harassed the previous Ambiyaa ﵊ throughout history. You Muslims should therefore remember the time)
When Moosa ﵊ said to his people, “O my people! Why do you harass me when you know that I am Allaah's Rasool (sent) to you?” However, when they chose to be crooked
(to reject his message despite its clarity),
(allowed them the chance to express more opposition).
Allaah does not guide a sinful
(because they reject every means of guidance Allaah sends to them).
v.s: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, “O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of God to you?” And when they deviated, God caused their hearts to deviate. And God does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
v.c: ˹Remember, O Prophet,˺ when Moses said to his people, “O my people! Why do you hurt me when you already know I am Allah’s messenger to you?” So when they ˹persistently˺ deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. For Allah does not guide the rebellious people.

q: When Isa the son of Maryam said, “O children of Israa'eel! Indeed I am the Rasool of Allaah
to you, confirming the Torah before me and giving
the good news of a Rasool to come after me

(referring to Rasulullaah ﷺ ego.'' (The name Ahmad, which Isa ﵊ used to refer to Rasulullaah ﷺ has been translated in Greek manuscripts of the Bible as “Periclytos” or “Paraclete”. In English Bibles, this word is deliberately mistranslated into words such as “Counselor”, “Comforter”, “Intercessor”, “Spirit of truth” and sometimes even “Holy Spirit”.)
(miracles to prove that he was a Rasool),
v.s: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, “O children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of God to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Ahmad.” But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, “This is obvious magic.”
v.c: And ˹remember˺ when Jesus, son of Mary, said, “O children of Israel! I am truly Allah’s messenger to you, confirming the Torah which came before me, and giving good news of a messenger after me whose name will be Aḥmad.” Yet when the Prophet came to them with clear proofs, they said, “This is pure magic.”

q: Who can be more unjust than he who forges lies about Allaah
when he is being called to Islaam? Allaah does not guide unjust people
(the Kuffaar who refuse to accept the truth despite acknowledging that it is the truth).
v.s: And who is more unjust than one who invents about God untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
v.c: Who does more wrong than the one who fabricates lies about Allah when invited to submit ˹to Him˺? For Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

q: (but this is insignificant when compared to Allaah's might).
However, Allaah shall bring His light to completion
(so that it enters every home on earth)
even though the Kaafiroon hate it.
v.s: They want to extinguish the light of God with their mouths, but God will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.
v.c: They wish to extinguish Allah’s light with their mouths, but Allah will ˹certainly˺ perfect His light, even to the dismay of the disbelievers.

q: Who sent His Rasool ﷺ with guidance and the true Deen
to make it dominant over all other religions, even though the Mushrikeen may hate it.'
v.s: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with God dislike it.
v.c: He is the One Who has sent His Messenger with ˹true˺ guidance and the religion of truth, making it prevail over all others, even to the dismay of the polytheists.

q: O you who have Imaan! Should I not show you a trade
(something that requires a small capital outlay and promises tremendous profits)
that will save you from a painful punishment
v.s: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?
v.c: O believers! Shall I guide you to an exchange that will save you from a painful punishment?

q: Believe in Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ and strive in Allaah's path
(Belief, good actions and Jihaad bring success.)
v.s: [It is that] you believe in God and His Messenger and strive in the cause of God with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you should know.
v.c: ˹It is to˺ have faith in Allah and His Messenger, and strive in the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if only you knew.

q: Allaah shall forgive your sins and enter you into Jannaat beneath which rivers flow and into wonderful mansions in the eternal Jannah. That
(and not the temporary gains of this world)
v.s: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.
v.c: He will forgive your sins, and admit you into Gardens under which rivers flow, and ˹house you in˺ splendid homes in the Gardens of Eternity. That is the ultimate triumph.

q: (bounty that you will receive for this is one)
(because you will see it in this world, and that)
is help from Allaah and a near
v.s: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from God and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.
v.c: ˹He will also give you˺ another favour that you long for: help from Allah and an imminent victory. ˹So˺ give good news ˹O Prophet˺ to the believers.

q: O you who have Imaan! Be the helpers of
(by assisting to propagate it in every way,)
Isa the son of Maryam said to the disciples
replied, “We shall be the helpers of
(Consequently, they actively engaged in propagating the Deen that Isa ﵊ taught them.)
a group of the Bani Israa'eel had Imaan while a group of them rejected Imaan
(and the two parties clashed in opposition). (As is Our promise,)
those with Imaan against their enemies and they
v.s: O you who have believed, be supporters of God, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for God?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of God." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.
v.c: O believers! Stand up for Allah, as Jesus, son of Mary, asked the disciples, “Who will stand up with me for Allah?” The disciples replied, “We will stand up for Allah.” Then a group from the Children of Israel believed while another disbelieved. We then supported the believers against their enemies, so they prevailed.
